Inland farm and acreage parcels

The remaining listings we checked are inland acreage/farm listings on 34b Avenue and 64 Street, per their listing texts — working farms and bare agricultural land under the Agriculture (A) designation and A1 zoning where the zone applies, farm parcels with equestrian facilities within the A1 stall limit, and operations using migrant farm worker housing under the A1 criteria. Farm parcels carry at most the A1 dwelling set in — none of it is strata condo stock.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Plans and farm zoning: the inland farmland is covered by Delta's city-wide Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 8400, 2024), which designates it "Agriculture (A)". The A1 Agriculture zone is for farming, pet breeding, kennels and related uses.

Nearby areas: Ladner village and its sub-areas (Hawthorne, Holly, Delta Manor, Neilsen Grove) to the east, East Delta beyond them, Westham Island to the west, and Tsawwassen to the south. Ladner's known condo stock sits in those village sub-areas — none of it is in Ladner Rural.

Flood and drainage geography: the City of Delta operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure (dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection), 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure; in the agricultural area the ditches and pump stations function in drainage mode in winter and in irrigation mode in summer, when ditch water is used to irrigate crops, with control gate structures regulating water levels.

Transit and health care: TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), and Ladner Exchange sits beside Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, Delta — Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with 24/7 emergency care.

ALR homes can't be stratified: the Agricultural Land Commission treats a strata plan as a subdivision, and farmland can't be subdivided without the Commission's permission. So farmland in Ladner Rural has farm houses and farm homes, never strata condos, which is why there are none here.

A1 housing rules (what this area allows): farming is the main use, and the zone allows a farm house, one secondary suite in it, an additional farm home, migrant farm worker housing, and equestrian facilities with up to 40 permanent stalls. One farm house per lot, up to 500 m², on a home plate of up to 3,600 m² (5,000 m² if there's also an additional farm house). One additional farm home per lot, up to 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger lots, on the same home plate; more than one needs Agricultural Land Commission approval. An additional farm house (up to 180 m² on lots under 8 ha, or 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) needs a professional agrologist's report showing it's needed and written Commission approval.
There are no strata buildings in Ladner Rural, so there's no Form B to ask for. If a float home is presented as strata, ask for the Form B and the strata plan before accepting that.

Rental and age bylaws (strata rules): rental-restriction bylaws are void since November 24, 2022, and only a 55+ age bylaw is lawful (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, with exemptions for legacy residents, live-in caregivers and, from May 1, 2023, younger spouses/partners and defined children) — both are strata-bylaw rules and neither has a building to apply to in Ladner Rural.
The guide's scope is wider than the area page's — on paper only. A buyer comparing the two pages should know the guide's extra geography has no known content behind it yet.

There are no condos here because of the rules, not the market: ALR homes can't be stratified, so no condo building can be built here. Treat a "Ladner Rural condo coming soon" claim as an error unless someone shows you a non-ALR property and a registered strata plan.
The same ditch is drainage in winter and irrigation in summer. In Delta's agricultural area the City's ditches and pump stations switch modes seasonally under control gates.
There are no Ladner Rural statistics to quote — and no substitute is allowed. SnapStats does not cover South Delta and publishes no farm, acreage or float-home category.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Ladner Rural
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple farm parcels are the inland land form: From the official material: working farms and bare agricultural land under Agriculture (A) / A1, farm parcels with equestrian facilities within the A1 stall limit (a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming), and operations using migrant farm worker housing under the A1 criteria.

The A1 zone: farming is the main use, and the zone allows a farm house, one secondary suite in it, an additional farm home, migrant farm worker housing, and equestrian facilities with up to 40 permanent stalls. One farm house per lot, up to 500 m², on a home plate of up to 3,600 m² (5,000 m² if there's also an additional farm house).
Lot character, only: no typical lot size is stated for the sub-area.

There's no published figure for how much of the area is in the ALR, though much of it is. Check a specific property's status on the Agricultural Land Commission's maps by address or PID; the Commission says its online tools are for general reference only, and its mapping team gives official confirmation.
Bare-land strata: none — and barred on ALR ground: On ALR ground the form is barred in any case: residences in the ALR cannot be stratified.

Float homes — documented as a tenure question, never as lot stock: The West River Road cards are float homes in a marina setting per their listing texts, with boat slips described as part of, or rented through, the complex, and strata-style language (garage, reserved parking, slips) in those texts.

Water, drainage and flood are part of the land here: the City operates and maintains 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure; in the agricultural area the ditches and pump stations function in drainage mode in winter and in irrigation mode in summer, when water in the ditches is used to irrigate crops, with control gate structures regulating water levels for agricultural use. The City also operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure between the Fraser River, Boundary Bay and Georgia Strait.

items.t: The acreage figures in those texts are listing text, cited here as feed composition only, not as verified parcel facts.
Ladner Rural is the farmland around Ladner — hobby farms, bigger working farms and country homes on acreage, much of it in the Agricultural Land Reserve, a short drive from Ladner Village.

Getting around: TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station, and Ladner Exchange sits beside Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd (Fraser Health community hospital, 24/7 emergency care).

SD37 publishes catchment boundary maps for the Ladner Area (elementary and secondary, updated October 2017) and directs families to the Baragar School Locator or their local school — a map/document-based statement, not a School Locator check.
SnapStats does not cover South Delta / Ladner (its Delta coverage is North Delta only, never used here), and it publishes no farm, acreage or float-home category.

ALR rules cover most of this area: homes can't be stratified, subdividing needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, the main house can be up to 500 m² with a suite only inside it, and an additional home can be up to 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (larger). Delta's A1 zone matches this: one additional farm home per lot on the same home plate as the farm house, with Commission approval for more than one, and an additional farm house (up to 180 m² on lots under 8 ha, or 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) only with a professional agrologist's report and written Commission approval. Migrant farm worker housing is allowed only where, among other things, the lot is in the ALR, classed as a farm, at least 4 ha, part of a farm of at least 8 ha, and approved in writing by the Commission.

Migrant worker housing has a hard size gate. A1 permits it only where the employing farm is at least 8 ha and the lot at least 4 ha, the lot is in the ALR and farm-classified, and written ALC approval is in hand — and new buildings for it must be manufactured homes on a temporary foundation or footings. A parcel under those thresholds cannot add it by right.
The 8 ha rule is a subdivision floor, not a parcel description.

items.t: Duplexes aren't really a thing here. faq.a: The sub-area's housing is farm houses and farm dwelling units on ALR/A1 ground (which cannot be stratified) plus float homes on West River Road, which are moorage product, not strata apartment condos. Ladner's known condo buildings are all in the village sub-areas.
faq.q: Are there any condos in Ladner Rural?

faq.a: Because stratification is a subdivision, and ALR land cannot be subdivided without Agricultural Land Commission permission: ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6 treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision, ALCA s. 21(1) bars subdividing agricultural land unless permitted by the Commission or the ALR General Regulation, and the Strata Property Act s. 239 route does not get around that bar.
faq.q: Why can't a farm property here be turned into condos?

faq.a: The listing texts present the West River Road homes with strata-style language and boat slips. Diligence the tenure first: establish what is actually owned (the float, the slip, any lease or strata interest), what the moorage costs and rules are, and how financing and insurance treat a float home, before pricing it like a condo.
faq.q: Is a Canoe Pass float home a condo?

faq.a: No — ALR residences cannot be stratified.
faq.q: Can ALR land be stratified into townhouses?

faq.a: The title says it does; the body read does not.
faq.q: Does this guide actually cover Westham Island?

faq.a: Delta's A1 zone permits one farm house per lot at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate). One accessory farm dwelling unit per lot is permitted — 90 m² or less on lots of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger lots — on the same farm home plate; more than one needs ALC approval, and an additional farm house needs an agrologist's necessity report plus written ALC approval.
faq.q: How big can a house be on ALR land here, and can it have a second dwelling?

faq.a: Not on any documented form here: A new A1 lot needs a minimum of 8 ha, OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable, apart from the home site severance exception. Do not price subdivision potential the A1 rule does not support.
faq.q: Can I subdivide a farm parcel into two half-duplex lots?

faq.a: Delta's agricultural ditches run in drainage mode in winter and irrigation mode in summer under City control gates — get the parcel's ditch, drainage and irrigation position from the City, not from a listing's wording; and establish the flood construction level for the exact parcel before designing a farm house, because the lowland is diked floodplain and the level is property-specific.
faq.q: What should I check about water and flooding on a farm parcel?

faq.a: Because they sit inside the same sub-area: two of the five listings we checked are float homes on West River Road naming the Canoe Pass community and boat slips in their listing texts, alongside inland acreage and farm listings on 34b Avenue and 64 Street.
